name: gitvoice
description: Turn client GitHub activity into clear, polished invoices — Cloudflare Worker + D1/R2 + Workers AI, with a private admin workspace and password-protected client portal. Open source. Agent-ready.
author: idea-torx

scripts.dev:local: node scripts/ensure-dev-vars.mjs && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc --var APP_ORIGIN:http://localhost:8787
scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply invoicer-pro --config wrangler.local.jsonc --remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.jsonc
